mapper.select: SELECT ds.id, ds.role_id, ds.scope_type, ds.created_at, ds.updated_at FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_role_data_scope ds ON r.id = ds.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT rso.org_id FROM sys_role_scope_org rso INNER JOIN sys_org o ON rso.org_id = o.id WHERE rso.role_id = #{roleId} AND o.status = 1

WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS ( SELECT id, org_name, parent_id, org_type, status, created_at FROM sys_org WHERE id = #{orgId} AND status = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT child.id, child.org_name, child.parent_id, child.org_type, child.status, child.created_at FROM sys_org child INNER JOIN org_tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.status = 1 )
SELECT id, org_name, parent_id, org_type, status, created_at FROM org_tree
SELECT id, org_name, parent_id, org_type, status, created_at FROM sys_org WHERE id = #{orgId} AND status = 1
